fix.cause: Obsidian 1.15.1 replaced prototype tokenizers with indexed rule tables and explicit parser/frame arguments.

offlineAssertions: Insertion removal reproduces each original app/worker byte for byte.
Alias HTML matches native dollar HTML; native dollar sections and metadata remain unchanged.
Links, tags, headings and math ranges retain original source positions; code examples remain literal.
Paragraph, list, quote and footnote interruption are covered.
Missing, ambiguous or differently scoped native bindings are refused.
limits: Physical device activation and restart tested on Android Obsidian 1.15.1/build 404; 1.15.0 is an offline recovered original fixture.
No new exhaustive touch/IME matrix; editor wrapper and native interaction implementations are unchanged.
One cached cold start does not establish a performance comparison; the 1665 ms metric starts at WebView navigation, not an icon tap.
External cache-removal recovery was tested in 0.2.0 and not repeated here; bootstrap and persistence mechanism unchanged.
Future unknown parser or container changes can still require another helper update.
Desktop and iOS activation are not implemented by this Android helper.
